1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the requests are specifically directed to bankruptcy proceedings and the data records contain debtor-specific financial information required for bankruptcy filings; automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records by formatting the debtor-specific financial information according to the requirements of each bankruptcy organization, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations by electronically transmitting the formatted bankruptcy documents directly to the respective bankruptcy organizations' filing systems.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the method includes adapting the bankruptcy documents to comply with each court's specific filing format requirements and procedural rules.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim that contains creditor-specific claim information and debtor identification; automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records by formatting the creditor-specific claim information according to each bankruptcy organization's proof of claim requirements, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations by electronically submitting the formatted proofs of claims directly to the respective bankruptcy court filing systems.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the proofs of claims are automatically reformatted to comply with each court's specific proof of claim form requirements and procedural rules.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors regarding specific debtors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that specific debtors have filed for bankruptcy and provide case-specific information including case numbers and filing dates.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol with encryption and authentication verification specific to each creditor's identity.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site with creditor authentication and validation of submitted claim data prior to processing.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims by bankruptcy organization and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day to each respective bankruptcy organization's filing system.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising: generating a report specific to a creditor's filed proofs of claims; and sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site with customizable report parameters.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed, including reasons specific to each bankruptcy organization's filing requirements or system status.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim from the bankruptcy organization's filing system.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer that interfaces directly with the different bankruptcy organizations' filing systems.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record against the specific filing requirements of each bankruptcy organization to which the proof of claim will be filed.
